title: Multimodal Graph RAG for Long-range Visually Rich Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2606.28780v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely applied to visual document understanding. However, comprehending long documents remains an issue by the limited context window. Though recent multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (MMRAG) can address this challenge by retrieving relevant pages. It still struggles with the visual question answering (VQA) requiring holistic comprehension of a document. To cope with this, knowledge graph (KG) that summarizes global knowledge of a document can provide an effective solution. However, most existing LLM-based KG construction methods handle only the language modality, leaving the automatic creation of multimodal KGs (MMKGs) for visually rich documents largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce a multimodal graph-based RAG approach to tackle this problem. translated_title: 面向长程视觉富文档理解的多模态图RAG
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）被广泛应用于视觉文档理解。然而，由于上下文窗口的限制，理解长文档仍然是一个难题。尽管最近的多模态检索增强生成（MMRAG）可以通过检索相关页面来应对这一挑战，但它仍然难以处理需要整体理解文档的视觉问答（VQA）任务。为了解决这一问题，总结文档全局知识的知识图谱（KG）可以提供一种有效的解决方案。然而，大多数现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的KG构建方法仅处理语言模态，针对视觉富文档的多模态知识图谱（MMKGs）自动构建在很大程度上尚未被探索。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于多模态图的RAG方法来解决这一问题。现有的基于LLM的KG方法依赖于间接证据（如全面性、多样性等）来评估问答性能……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态图结构的检索增强生成（RAG）方法，通过自动构建多模态知识图谱来总结文档的全局知识，从而解决了长视觉富文档需要整体理解时的视觉问答难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multimodal graph-based RAG approach that automatically constructs multimodal knowledge graphs to capture global document knowledge, addressing visual question answering tasks that require holistic comprehension of long visually rich documents.
